DESCRIPTION:
Rancho Biosciences provides EHR/EMR integration services that bridge clinical systems with research and regulatory data models, enabling seamless data flow across healthcare and life sciences environments. Our experts align patient, clinical, and outcome data to industry standards such as CDISC, OMOP, and HL7 FHIR, ensuring interoperability, compliance, and readiness for downstream analytics.

By combining automation with expert-driven validation, Rancho transforms heterogeneous clinical data into harmonized, analysis-ready formats that support real-world evidence studies, regulatory submissions, and translational research. We tailor each integration to your existing infrastructure, whether connecting commercial EHR platforms or custom data warehouses, so your clinical data can be securely and effectively reused for insight generation and innovation.
